title: One Thing After Another
text:
One Thing After Another

Louis-Vincent Gave

Gavekal Research | 29 Oct 2026

It has been a busy week. Brazil’s election and consequent wild market moves caught the headlines (see Buy The Dip In Brazil and Brazil Joins The List) but the Brazilian election was hardly the only important event. British Columbia also held an important election. Anthropic announced an initial public offering for the week of November 16. Iran, Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sat down for strategic talks. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that Ukraine would accept a ceasefire and a peace deal along the current lines of effective control (see Shudders In The Tech Complex). China cut interest rates… though not really (see Switching The Policy Rate). China also started to enforce its crackdown on offshore trust structures and, going in the opposite direction, India announced that it may change the country’s long-term capital gains tax structure. Finally, Israel held its election. In fairness, any of these events would probably be worth a Daily, or even an Ideas piece. But in the spirit of the advertisement that Kraft Macaroni and Cheese used to run in Canada, namely that “sometimes we do better; and sometimes we are pressed for time”, I thought that addressing these various issues in a quick go-to list would make more sense.
